_capture.method: NOT CAPTURED. Fixture-only: the one live capture attempted for a FUZZY response was declined in the capture session, so no real FUZZY body is available.
_capture.note: Minimal GBIF species/match response shape (usageKey, scientificName, canonicalName, rank, status, confidence, matchType) as documented at https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi/v1/species. The names are deliberately fictional ('Fixturea') and are not taxonomic content. Used only to pin that FUZZY maps to unresolved and is never adopted.
